explanation: Mathlib's `Submodule.comap_map_eq_of_injective (hf : Injective f) (p : Submodule R M) : (p.map f).comap f = p` (Map.lean:359) is the general statement. Unfolding the library definitions gives exactly this instance: `Submodule.submoduleOf p q` is by definition `comap q.subtype p` (Map.lean:273), and the library lemma `evenSublattice_carrier` identifies `L.evenSublattice.carrier` with `L.evenSubmodule.map L.carrier.subtype`; so the goal becomes `(L.evenSubmodule.map L.carrier.subtype).comap L.carrier.subtype = L.evenSubmodule`, which is `comap_map_eq_of_injective` applied to the specific injective map `L.carrier.subtype` and `p := L.evenSubmodule`. Mathlib has no statement about `evenSublattice`/`evenSubmodule` itself (and no general `(p.map q.subtype).submoduleOf q = p`), so this is a special case, not a duplicate; the library's proof already uses this lemma.
